per_line.quote: Designed and deployed end-to-end ETL pipelines processing >10 million records daily, cutting data latency from 12 h to 4 h ( 67 % reduction).
per_line.why: Data engineering is the main line of work: ETL and pipeline projects, data stacks and data-engineer CVs.

per_line.quote: Data Analysis & Visualization: Power BI, DAX, Power Query, BigQuery, Excel (advanced), Tableau
per_line.why: A business and data analyst (CV 10), a BI consultant (CV 05) and several BI / analytics records.

per_line.quote: Data Engineer Jun 2024 – Present
per_line.why: No document describes a statistical study; forecasting (time series), clustering and predictive models are related analytical work.
'Restitution de données' is French for data reporting (reports, dashboards): the BI reporting records and BI CVs prove it.

per_line.line: The quality of the organization setup must be demonstrated
per_line.why: Award criterion on the bid's own organisation for this contract; no CV or record can prove it. Delivery-management CVs (CV 14, CV 04) are related, not proof.

per_line.line: The quality of the start of a service must be demonstrated
per_line.why: Award criterion on how this contract will start; no document can prove it. The hyper-care process (CV 04) is related, not proof.

per_line.quote: Consultant – MSBI / Power BI Aug 2023 – Jan 2024
per_line.why: Administrative proof (turnover, balance sheets) that the knowledge base does not hold; 'financial reporting' lines in CVs are not proof.

per_line.line: Le système doit permettre l'analyse d'images issues de systèmes de vidéoprotection et de caméras aéroportées
per_line.why: Computer vision is a declared service (AI Development stack) and two CVs have academic image projects (facial recognition with OpenCV, image retrieval); no video-surveillance or aerial-camera work.
The generative AI content agent (project record and CV 12, AI engineer 2024-2026) is an LLM agent; CV 06 built a RAG assistant on LLaMA.
Demo web projects and stack; real proof: CV 11 (React, Node.js and PostgreSQL portal) and CV 16 (Django and React web applications).

per_line.quote: Programming: Python, SQL, Bash, Java, C
per_line.why: Node.js and Spring demo projects; real proof: CV 11 (Node.js portal). Java without Spring in many skills lists is a passing proof.

per_line.quote: Databases: MySQL, phpMyAdmin, PostgreSQL
per_line.why: Demo projects and stacks; six CVs use PostgreSQL (CV 09 migrated PostgreSQL databases).

per_line.quote: Integrated RESTful APIs for payment processing, achieving a 99.9% transaction success rate and handling over 5,000 daily transactions.
per_line.why: Demo stack and licensing portal (REST API integration); real proof: CV 02 and CV 16 integrated RESTful APIs.

per_line.quote: Implemented Terraform-based IaC for AWS and Azure resources, cutting manual provisioning effort by 40 % and eliminating configuration drift.
per_line.why: Many demo records and CVs (AWS certificates CV 01 and CV 14, Azure work in CV 03, 07, 09, 13, 19).

No document states an ISO 27001 certificate. ISO 27001 compliance work (CV 17, CV 18) and 'ISO 27001-aligned' or consulting stacks are related, not a certification; the insurance ISO 27001 project is a draft.
Senior developers: CV 14 (9+ years, web developer 2016-2025, now delivery manager) and arguably CV 02 (software developer since June 2021). Fewer than 3.

per_line.quote: Project Management Professional (PMP), PMI – 2022
per_line.why: CV 17 holds the PMP (PMI, 2022).
Nobody is a UX/UI designer by role; CV 10, a business analyst, did freelance UX/UI design (Figma, Adobe XD).
Three completed public-sector digital demo projects. The network-hardware, security-software supply and AI-training projects are public but hardly digital projects.

per_line.quote: AI & Machine Learning: LLM fine-tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, LangChain, Prompt Engineering
per_line.why: Demo RAG chatbot, stack and accelerator; real proof: CV 06 (RAG assistant on LLaMA) and CV 12 (LangChain and Pinecone RAG).
Only the telecom chatbot answers in French and Arabic. A person's language skills (CV language lines) do not prove that a system responds in them.

per_line.quote: Integrated LangChain and Pinecone vector databases to power semantic search and Retrieval-Augmented Generation, cutting content-generation latency by 55 %.
per_line.why: Demo stack (vector databases) and chatbot (vector search); real proof: CV 12 (Pinecone vector databases); CV 06 built vector indexing.

per_line.quote: Designed an automated ETL workflow (Python + Airflow) that reduced data refresh time from 48 h to 6 h.
per_line.why: Every CV but CV 08 lists Python; six describe Python work.

per_line.quote: Data & AI Engineer with a strong passion for building scalable data and AI systems.
per_line.why: CV 18 is a Data & AI Engineer; CV 12 was OliveSoft's AI engineer 2024-2026; CV 06 was an AI engineer (RAG assistant) in 2025.

per_line.quote: Dynamic Technical Delivery Manager with over 9 years of experience leading cross-functional software teams, delivering large-scale web solutions, and driving De
per_line.why: CV 17 holds the PMP; CV 14 and CV 04 are delivery managers (CV 14 was a project manager before).

per_line.line: 1 chatbot or AI assistant project reference
per_line.why: The completed demo telecom RAG chatbot. CVs are not company project references.

per_line.quote: Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into interactive Power BI dashboards and scalable data warehouses, delivering measurable efficiency ga
per_line.why: Demo dashboard, stack and licences; real proof: PL-300 holders CV 05 and CV 10, Power BI work in CV 13 and CV 04.

per_line.quote: Proficient in Python, SQL, and cloud-native data platforms, delivering scalable solutions that improve data reliability and reduce processing time by up to 35 %
per_line.why: Demo Airflow pipelines; real proof: Python and Airflow ingestion pipelines in CV 07, 09 and 13, Python data platform in CV 15.

per_line.quote: Evaluated Azure ML and Kubeflow on AKS, delivering a comparative report that guided a EUR 200 k investment decision.
per_line.why: Demo Azure projects and stacks; many CVs work on Azure (AKS, Data Factory, Data Lake).

per_line.quote: Dynamic Technical Delivery Manager with over 9 years of experience leading cross-functional software teams, delivering large-scale web solutions, and driving De
per_line.why: Same as R25.

per_line.quote: Data Engineer with 3+ years of experience designing and operating end-to-end data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, and BI solutions.
per_line.why: Eight CVs are data engineers by their current job.
The completed demo national health analytics dashboard (sector public / health).
Only the demo mobile stack names Flutter; no CV does.

per_line.quote: Programming: Apex, LWC, JavaScript, SOQL, SOSL, HTML/CSS, SQL
per_line.why: Real proof only: CV 08 (Salesforce APIs sync, Talend migration to Salesforce), CV 04 (Sales Cloud implementations), CV 06 (Data Cloud). No demo record names Salesforce.

per_line.quote: Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm
per_line.why: CV 01 (CKA, three production clusters), CV 03 (AKS), CV 15 and CV 16 ran workloads on Kubernetes; the demo public-sector stack lists it.

per_line.quote: Provisioned Google Cloud resources with Terraform; reduced infrastructure-as-code deployment time by 40 %.
per_line.why: Real proof only: Terraform IaC in CV 01, 03, 11 and 15. No demo record names Terraform.
At most two senior developers (see R16).

per_line.quote: Certified Scrum Master (CSM) – Scrum Alliance, 2022
per_line.why: Nobody holds the PSM; CV 14 holds the Scrum Alliance CSM, an equivalent certification: partial with a note, not covered.
One health-sector project of the two asked.
